text: At its December 4, 2017 meeting the Transportation Working Group, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee requested that the General Manager, Transportation Services present to the Committee on the final rules for the Bloor Street bike lines, with respect to accessibility, and to consider input from the Committee on future bike lane construction.

The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services to provide an update to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2018 on the current rules for the Bloor Street bike lanes, with respect to accessibility, and to consider any input from the Committee on future bike lane construction.
